caption: The drawing depicts a single large bronze bell with a distinct yoke mounted above it. The bell has a flared, curved lower edge and a rounded crown at the top. The yoke, which is attached horizontally at the top of the bell, is depicted in a brownish metallic hue and bears the inscription “NO 80 YOKE” in raised letters. Each end of the yoke terminates in a horizontally oriented cylindrical fitting with protruding bolts or axles, which appear to be mounting points. The surface of the bell is rendered in shades of brown, gold, and hints of greenish-blue, illustrating highlights and patina. The background of the drawing is an off-white color, and the composition centers the bell with some empty space around it. The lower right corner bears the name "L.B. Hartmann" in small, capitalized letters.
title: Church Bell
